firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html: h1 'Rowhouse brick repointing in Baltimore' is 5 words with trade+city+outcome. Primary call button and ghost Price-it link in hero headline tile. Phone visible in header, hero, mobile bar. Proof line with sample-tagged 4.8 rating. Hero uses Flemish-bond mosaic (6 tiles). CSS clamp keeps h1 short; sec-loose padding allows next band peek.

distinctiveness.notes: dist/index.html: bond-grid signature in hero, trust/stats, services, reviews, footer (data-sw-signature on each). Three layout families: mosaic hero, hotspot story break, two-column tool layouts. Barlow Condensed + Karla + DM Mono unique per concept.json. Soot+Baltimore Red+Brass palette differs from siblings.

type.notes: dist/index.html: Barlow Condensed display at -0.03em tracking, 0.92 line-height. Karla body >=16px via fs-0 clamp. DM Mono for sample tags, prices, ZIP, tool readouts. Fluid scale with 6 sizes. Tabular-nums on counters. Lead paragraph max-width 65ch. Kicker uppercase tracked. text-wrap:balance on headings.

layout.notes: dist/index.html: 10 sections each with one job. Alternating tones deep/paper/mid/paper/deep/accent/paper/mid/paper/deep. Full-bleed break at elevation. Asymmetric tool layouts at >=1100px. Round 2 fix: services section now uses paired svc-price header tiles and svc-tile stretcher tiles in true Flemish-bond alternation (lines 1033-1131), replacing the flat auto-fill grid. Density map no longer flat.

photo.notes: dist/index.html: all images are placeholders with descriptive alt text. Consistent CSS filter for grade uniformity. Width/height attributes present. Lazy loading on non-hero. No duplicates. Deductions: no real art direction or sequence storytelling (-1.0), no video despite concept mentioning poster (-0.5), hero alt text improved but others still generic. Expected in placeholder mode; above floor 6.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: voice matches concept sentences. Sample tags on every review, price, guarantee, rating. Buttons named for action (Price it, Call, Check, Send). No banned phrases. No tricolons. Primary action consistently 'Price it'. CTA band uses verbatim concept sentence. Form thanks message honest about demo nature.

mobile.notes: dist/index.html CSS: <900px bond grids collapse to 2col, hero to 1col. Tool layouts single-column. Hotspots become static stacked cards. Mobile bar fixed bottom with flex:1 buttons min-height 48px. Form inputs 48px. No horizontal scroll. Break-bg hidden on mobile. Pinned story correctly un-pins under 640px.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: skip-link present. focus-visible 3px solid var(--focus) offset 3px. All inputs labeled. aria-live on ZIP, checklist, estimator results. Hotspots have role=button tabindex=0 aria-label. Menu has aria-expanded/controls. Reduced-motion safety net shows all content. JS-off hides controls but keeps content visible. Forced colors handled. Heading order h1->h2 intact; trust band sr-only h2 added in round 2 (line 943).

motion.notes: dist/index.html: clip-path unclip stagger on hero tiles. Split-text h1 line reveal. Hover brass hairline scaleX on ghost buttons and tiles. Three hooks: mortar-match live panel, estimator sketch, hotspot cards. Reduced motion respected. Deductions: same translateY reveal on most sections (-0.5); elevation hotspots are click-triggered not scroll-driven auto-light sequence as concept promised (-0.5).

wow.notes: dist/index.html: mortar-match live CSS brick panel tied to thesis. Facade estimator with SVG sketch updates reactively. Both outputs use signature language (accent borders, mono numerals, sample tags). Deduction: two tools are disconnected rather than connected moments sharing signature motion; neither animates in sync with the bond-grid system.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon. OG 1200x630. theme-color. JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness with openingHoursSpecification. Print stylesheet for estimator. All images have width/height. Hero preloaded. Forced colors handled. Consistent 2px radius. One icon stroke-width. Footer designed with bond-grid and maker-mark. Credits links fixed to spans in round 2 (line 1398); static.json clean.

elevate.move: Differentiate entrances by role: let tool preview panels use clip-path reveals tied to their control interactions, let stat numbers count up on scroll, and let the elevation hotspots auto-light in sequence as the concept describes, giving the scroll a readable report-assembled shape.

Vary the duotone filter treatment by section role instead of applying a uniform filter: cooler desaturated tones for diagnostic/tool sections, warmer richer tones for proof sections, creating visual rhythm that reinforces the report-assembled thesis even with placeholder media.
